description: Flat metadata schema for individual TEM image/observation records from genetically modified plant cells with immunogold labeling of tagged proteins.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual TEM image or observation record.

dataset_sample_id.descr: Identifier linking the record to the biological sample or specimen block from which the TEM section was obtained.

species.descr: Plant species used for the sample, e.g., Arabidopsis thaliana, Nicotiana benthamiana.

cultivar_or_ecotype.descr: Cultivar, ecotype, or accession name of the plant line, if applicable.

plant_line_name.descr: Name or identifier of the genetically modified or control plant line.

genotype_description.descr: Free-text description of the genotype, including mutations, insertions, knockouts, overexpression constructs, and background line.

transgene_name.descr: Name of the expressed gene/protein of interest, including tagged protein construct name.

tag_type.descr: Type of tag fused to the protein of interest, e.g., GFP, HA, FLAG, Myc, His.

tag_position.descr: Position of the tag relative to the protein, e.g., N-terminal, C-terminal, internal.

promoter_name.descr: Promoter used to drive expression of the transgene, if known.

transformation_method.descr: Method used to generate the plant line, e.g., Agrobacterium-mediated transformation, biolistics, CRISPR edit, stable transformation.

zygosity_or_inheritance.descr: Genetic state of the line, e.g., homozygous, heterozygous, hemizygous, segregating.

phenotype_description.descr: Free-text description of visible or measured phenotype relevant to photosynthetic efficiency or stress response.

stress_condition.descr: Stress treatment applied to the plant prior to sampling, e.g., drought, salt, cold, high light, control/none.

stress_severity.descr: Quantitative or semi-quantitative severity of stress treatment, if available; use as standardized string if categorical.

developmental_stage.descr: Developmental stage of the plant tissue sampled, e.g., seedling, rosette, mature leaf, flowering.

tissue_type.descr: Tissue sampled for TEM, e.g., leaf mesophyll, guard cell, root, stem, embryo.

cell_type.descr: Specific cell type or cell population imaged, if known.

subcellular_compartment_targeted.descr: Organelle or subcellular compartment of interest, e.g., chloroplast, thylakoid, mitochondrion, nucleus, plasma membrane.

observed_localization_description.descr: Free-text summary of the observed immunogold signal distribution within the cell or organelle.

sample_fixative_primary.descr: Primary fixative used for sample preparation, e.g., glutaraldehyde, paraformaldehyde, osmium tetroxide.

sample_fixative_secondary.descr: Secondary or postfixative used, if applicable.

fixative_concentration_percent.descr: Concentration of the main fixative solution in percent (%), if a single numeric value applies.

fixation_temperature_c.descr: Temperature during fixation in degrees Celsius (°C).

dehydration_method.descr: Method used for dehydration before embedding, e.g., graded ethanol series, acetone series.

embedding_resin.descr: Embedding medium or resin used for TEM sample preparation, e.g., LR White, Spurr's resin, Epon.

embedding_temperature_c.descr: Temperature used during embedding/polymerization in degrees Celsius (°C), if relevant.

sectioning_method.descr: Method used for section preparation, e.g., ultramicrotomy, cryosectioning.

section_thickness_nm.descr: Thickness of the TEM section in nanometers (nm).

knife_type.descr: Knife type used for sectioning, e.g., diamond knife, glass knife.

mounting_substrate.descr: Support substrate used for sections, e.g., copper grid, nickel grid, formvar-coated grid.

stain_type.descr: Counterstain(s) used for TEM imaging, e.g., uranyl acetate, lead citrate, phosphotungstic acid.

immunogold_labeling_used.descr: Indicates whether immunogold labeling was performed for this record.

primary_antibody_target.descr: Antigen or epitope recognized by the primary antibody used for immunogold labeling.

primary_antibody_host.descr: Host species in which the primary antibody was raised, e.g., rabbit, mouse, goat.

primary_antibody_dilution.descr: Dilution of the primary antibody, expressed as a string such as 1:100 or 1:500.

secondary_antibody_host.descr: Host species of the secondary antibody, if applicable.

secondary_antibody_dilution.descr: Dilution of the secondary antibody, expressed as a string such as 1:20 or 1:100.

gold_particle_diameter_nm.descr: Diameter of the immunogold particle in nanometers (nm), e.g., 5, 10, 15.

labeling_protocol_reference.descr: Reference or protocol identifier describing the immunogold labeling workflow.

microscope_model.descr: TEM instrument model used for imaging.

accelerating_voltage_kv.descr: Accelerating voltage used during TEM imaging in kilovolts (kV).

camera_or_detector_model.descr: Camera or detector model used to capture the TEM images.

magnification.descr: Nominal magnification used for the recorded image.

pixel_size_nm.descr: Effective pixel size at specimen level in nanometers per pixel (nm/pixel).

exposure_time_ms.descr: Detector exposure time for the image in milliseconds (ms).

defocus_setting.descr: Defocus value or qualitative defocus setting used during image acquisition, if available.

acquisition_date.descr: Date when the TEM image was acquired, in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.

operator_name.descr: Name or identifier of the person who acquired the TEM image.

image_file_name.descr: File name of the stored image associated with this record.

image_format.descr: Digital image file format, e.g., TIFF, PNG, DM3, JPEG.

image_processing_applied.descr: Indicates whether post-acquisition image processing was applied, such as contrast adjustment or denoising.

image_processing_description.descr: Description of any post-processing steps applied to the image.

gold_particle_count.descr: Number of immunogold particles counted in the record, if quantified.

counting_region_description.descr: Description of the region of interest used for counting or localization analysis.

quantification_method.descr: Method used for quantifying localization or particle density, e.g., manual counting, automated segmentation.

particle_density_per_um2.descr: Calculated immunogold particle density normalized by area, in particles per square micrometer (particles/µm²).

notes.descr: Additional free-text notes relevant to the record.
